functions.//gate: Refuses to upload a payload containing the service account. On every entry rather than one, so that a partial deploy -- firebase deploy --only hosting:genoacms-demo-react -- is gated too. $RESOURCE_DIR is the directory being uploaded, so each unit checks its own bytes.

hosting.//: SvelteKit is server-rendered on a function, so anything Hosting has no file for goes there -- including /artifacts, which this application serves from its own route rather than from the shared function.

A static build. /artifacts is matched first and goes to the shared function; everything else falls back to index.html, because these are single-page applications. Order matters: a catch-all placed first would swallow the artifact requests and answer them with HTML.
